entities.summary: The Red Church is a Protestant Church in Brno, Czech Republic. It was designed by architect Heinrich von Ferstel and built up between 1863 and 1867. Nowadays it is used by the Evangelical Church of Czech Brethren. The building is a cultural monument. Red Church in Brno is a church building in Europe, established in 1863. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
